summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release updating progress on the Boumadine Project feasibility study and an updated preliminary economic assessment. The filing describes ongoing infill drilling, procurement and contractor tenders, water supply, power infrastructure, and metallurgical testwork. No specific transaction terms, prices, premiums, or deal mechanics are stated. The filing is a routine operational update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or capital return. Accordingly, this is not a special situation.
